# Dubplate MIDI functions

*Generated by `dubplate --midi-survey`; do not edit by hand.*

Every function a controller can be bound to, and the name each program uses for it. Use these names in the `func` field of a profile.

| Dubplate `func` | Does | Needs | DJUCED | Mixxx | rekordbox |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `play_pause` | Play / pause | `deck` | `play_pause` | `[ChannelN] play` | `PlayPause` |
| `cue` | CUE (press and release) | `deck` | `cue_stop` | `[ChannelN] cue_default`, `[ChannelN] cue_preview` | `Cue` |
| `to_start` | Jump to track start | `deck` | `stop` | `[ChannelN] start`, `[ChannelN] start_stop` | `JumpToTrackStart` |
| `sync` | SYNC to the other deck | `deck` | `sync` | `[ChannelN] beatsync`, `[ChannelN] sync_enabled` | `Sync` |
| `load` | Load the selected library track | `deck` | `browser_load_deck`, `browser_load_deck_or_expand` | `[ChannelN] LoadSelectedTrack` | `Load` |
| `loop_in` | Loop IN (press and release; hold = auto loop) | `deck` | `loop_in`, `loop_in_move` | `[ChannelN] loop_in` | `LoopIn` |
| `loop_out` | Loop OUT / exit / re-loop | `deck` | `loop_out`, `loop_out_move` | `[ChannelN] loop_out` | `LoopOut` |
| `loop_half` | Halve the loop | `deck` | `loop_half` | `[ChannelN] loop_halve` | `LoopHalf` |
| `loop_double` | Double the loop | `deck` | `loop_double` | `[ChannelN] loop_double` | `LoopDouble` |
| `loop_beats` | Auto loop of `arg` beats | `deck`, `arg` | `loop` | `[ChannelN] beatloop_N_activate`, `[ChannelN] beatloop_N_toggle` | `4BeatLoopLongPress` |
| `loop_toggle` | Loop on / off | `deck` | `loop_toggle` | `[ChannelN] reloop_andstop`, `[ChannelN] reloop_toggle` | `ReloopExit` |
| `pad` | Hot-cue pad `arg` (0-7) | `deck`, `arg` | `hot_cue` | `[ChannelN] hotcue_N_activate` | `PADn_HotCue` |
| `pad_delete` | Delete hot-cue pad `arg` (0-7) | `deck`, `arg` | `delete_cue` | `[ChannelN] hotcue_N_clear` | `PADn_HotCue+Shift` |
| `stem` | Mute stem `arg` (0 drums, 1 bass, 2 other, 3 vocals) | `deck`, `arg` | `stem_acapp`, `stem_bass`, `stem_drum`, `stem_instru`, `stem_melody`, `stem_voice` | — | — |
| `quantize` | Quantize on / off | `deck` | `toggle_quantization` | `[ChannelN] quantize` | `Quantize` |
| `jog_touch` | Jog top touch sensor | `deck` | `scratch` | `[ChannelN] scratch2_enable` | `JogTouch` |
| `volume` | Channel fader | `deck` | `level` | `[ChannelN] volume` | `ChannelFader` |
| `gain` | Trim / gain | `deck` | `gain` | `[ChannelN] pregain` | `Gain` |
| `eq_high` | EQ high | `deck` | `high` | `[ChannelN] filterHigh`, `[EqualizerRack1_[ChannelN]_Effect1] parameter3` | `EQHigh` |
| `eq_mid` | EQ mid | `deck` | `medium` | `[ChannelN] filterMid`, `[EqualizerRack1_[ChannelN]_Effect1] parameter2` | `EQMid` |
| `eq_low` | EQ low | `deck` | `bass` | `[ChannelN] filterLow`, `[EqualizerRack1_[ChannelN]_Effect1] parameter1` | `EQLow` |
| `filter` | Filter knob | `deck` | `set_pass_filter_amount` | `[QuickEffectRack1_[ChannelN]] super1` | `CFXParameterCHn` |
| `tempo` | Tempo fader | `deck` | `pitch` | `[ChannelN] rate` | `TempoSlider` |
| `jog_bend` | Jog outer ring (pitch bend) | `deck` | `pitch_bend` | `[ChannelN] jog` | `JogPitchBend`, `WheelPitchBend` |
| `jog_scratch` | Jog platter (scratch) | `deck` | `scratch` | — | `JogScratch` |
| `crossfader` | Crossfader | — | `crossfader` | `[Master] crossfader` | `CrossFader` |
| `browse` | Browser encoder | — | `browser_step_up_down`, `browser_up_down` | `[Library] MoveVertical`, `[Library] ScrollVertical` | `Browse` |
